polar-curves-rose.alt: The polar graph of r = 3 sin(2 theta): a rose with four petals of length 3, centered on the rays pi/4, 3 pi/4, 5 pi/4 and 7 pi/4, each starting and ending at the pole.

polar-curves-limacon.alt: The polar graph of r = 1 + 2 cos theta: a limacon with a large outer loop reaching farthest to the right and a small inner loop to the right of the pole.
